title: Merchandise Purchases — Cancelling an Order Line and Uncollected Store Pickups
content:
**Rule.** A Merchandise Purchases unit can be cancelled only while it is in ordered status — the cancellation cut-off is before shipment. Once it has shipped or been completed, the customer returns it instead.

- **At the customer's request.** Cancellation at the customer's request is made by customer care on the customer's word and needs no proof.
- **Pickup not collected.** A store pickup unit not collected within the class's store pickup hold period after it is ready is cancelled with the reason "pickup not collected".
- **Either way,** the full net paid amount is refunded to the original tender with no fee; a card charge that has not yet been captured is simply released; and Finch Notes allocated to the unit are reinstated under the Finch Circle rules.
- **One unit at a time.** Cancelling one unit never cancels the other units of its order number unless the customer asks for each.

## Status of the unit — what follows

| Status on the purchase record | Can the unit be cancelled? |
|---|---|
| ordered | Yes |
| shipped | No — it is returned instead |
| completed | No — it is returned instead |

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer asks to cancel one of three units on an order, all still in ordered status: that one unit is cancelled and refunded in full to the original tender; the other two stay on order unless the customer asks for each of them as well.
- A store pickup unit of a class with a 7-day hold, ready on 2 March and not collected within the 7 days that follow, is cancelled as not collected and refunded in full with no fee.
- A unit charged to a card whose payment had not yet been captured: the authorization is simply released.
